title: Clinical Experiment of Helicobacter Pylori Transmission
brief_summary: The study proposes to test whether chronic infection with Helicobacter pylori protects individuals from symptomatic infection with enteropathogenic E. coli. The study will also evaluate the effect of gastric acidity in this relationship.
raw_criteria: Inclusion Criteria:Healthy Exclusion Criteria:prior gastrointestinal disease prior treatment of H. pylori infection immune suppression or deficiency history of cancer, diabetes, or other co-morbidity
